title: AuditLogEntry
description: A single audit log record appended to audit-log.jsonl by the PostToolUse hook. Tracks all tool invocations and governance events.

entry_id.description: Unique identifier for this audit entry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this event was recorded.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or hook that generated this entry.

session_id.description: Claude Code session id from the hook payload. The join key to diagnostics events, run records and transcripts (ADR-0006 in cloud-catcher).

tool_use_id.description: Tool-use id from the hook payload, so a tool call can be matched to its transcript entry.

sprint_context.description: Sprint number at the time of this event, or null if outside sprint execution.

tool_name.description: Name of the Claude Code tool invoked (for tool-call events).

tool_input_summary.description: Brief summary of the tool input (not full content; privacy-safe).

andon_pull_count.description: Legacy running count of andon signals. Always null since the native-hook logger: andon pull-rate is a policy evaluated over event_type=andon-signal entries, not a counter incremented while logging (HKP-0003).

verification_spot_check.description: True if this entry records a verification spot-check (§8.2 Step 1C).

verification_command.description: The verification command that was re-run (for verification-spot-check entries).

linked_henka_id.description: HK-NNNN of a related henkaten record, if any.

linked_decision_id.description: DEC-NNNN of a related decision, if any.

notes.description: Additional context or notes for this entry.
